claims.statement: EU guidance promotes selective demolition and pre-demolition audits to enable reuse and high-quality recycling of construction materials.
The new Construction Products Regulation recognizes reuse and establishes interoperable digital product information including performance and conformity data.
Demand hypothesis: contractors will pay for reservations that reduce disposal cost without delaying demolition.

contrary_evidence: EU pre-demolition audit guidance is non-binding.
Used construction products may lack sufficient declarations or require fresh assessment before reuse.

economics.acquisition_route: Demand hypothesis: three demolition contractors can supply the first 20 scheduled projects without consumer marketing
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 250 projects yearly at 18000 PLN blended audit and fee revenue yields 4.5m PLN; 25% EBITDA at a 5x value could exceed 5m PLN in 5-7 years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly with field surveys performed by contractors
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 55-70% after survey partners; remote reuse of drawings and computer vision should lower repeat audit cost
economics.payback: Economics hypothesis: 10 projects at 9000 PLN average audit revenue recover setup capital in 12-18 months
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 6000-15000 PLN per site inventory plus 5-8% of recovered-asset GMV
economics.retention_or_repeat: Owners and contractors repeat across portfolios; buyers set standing specifications and reserve future lots

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Exclusive early inventories, component price history, removal productivity, and buyer acceptance criteria
fingerprint.customer: Property owners, demolition contractors, architects, reuse dealers, and contractors buying reclaimed components
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Demolition firms, property managers, architectural practices, insurers, and municipal regeneration projects
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Owner mandate, pre-demolition inventory, document recovery, buyer qualification, reservation deposits, and removal scheduling
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Owner or demolition firm pays for the digital audit; seller and buyer pay a success fee when a reservation closes
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A renovation or demolition date is fixed but reusable materials lack early buyer commitments, documentation, and removal coordination

founder_fit: Computer vision and structured data can accelerate inventories
B2B portfolio sales limit social burden
Polish launch with EU regulatory portability
risks: Low lot value relative to removal cost

structure.commercial_archetype: Forward asset-rights marketplace with evidence services
structure.control_point: Owner-authorized pre-demolition inventory and reservation window before materials become mixed waste
structure.critical_dependency: Safe removal, credible performance evidence, and a lawful waste route for every unclaimed lot

thesis: Building owners grant time-bounded rights to survey and reserve recoverable components before demolition; buyers receive material identity, removal conditions, performance documents, and a waste fallback. Demand hypothesis: early control of the schedule and evidence packet is more valuable than another post-demolition classifieds site.
title: Pre-Demolition Salvage Rights Exchange
uncertainties: Owner willingness to grant early access
